name: APEX Signature
description:
APEX Signature allows you to capture signatures with customizable tools, timestamps, save templates, and sign documents. Features include drawing with color/thickness controls, image upload, webcam capture, undo/redo, eraser mode, date/time overlay, saved signature templates, and document signing with PDF overlay.

Version 3.4.0 New Features:

  • Timestamp Overlay: Add date/time to signatures
  • Multiple positions: Below, Right, Top-Right, Bottom-Right
  • Configurable date formats: ISO, US, EU, BR, custom
  • Audit info: IP address, geolocation, user name
  • Preview with timestamp before saving
  • Metadata export for audit trail

Version 3.3.0 Features:

  • Customization Toolbar: Color picker, thickness slider, eraser, undo/redo

Version 3.2.0 Features:

  • Signature Templates: Save and reuse signatures

Version 3.1.0 Features:

  • Document Signing: PDF/image with signature overlay

Version 3.0.0 Features:

  • Multi-Input Capture: Draw, Upload, Webcam
